name: Synthetic EHR Phenotype Benchmark
description: A benchmarking suite evaluating methods and open-source tools for generating synthetic electronic health record data focused on phenotype-level fidelity, utility, and privacy.
evaluation_method: Combination of statistical similarity metrics and privacy/utility measures (e.g., KS/JS divergence, feature-wise statistics, downstream task AUROC/accuracy, re-identification/membership-inference risk)
general_score_metric: Composite (statistical similarity + downstream utility such as AUROC + privacy risk metrics)
reputation: An emerging research benchmark in medical informatics for assessing synthetic EHR generators, used in academic evaluations though not yet an established standard.
notes: Outcomes depend heavily on original-data quality and evaluation choices; potential privacy leakage risks if synthetic generation is poorly constrained; multiple heterogeneous metrics complicate comparisons.
